inj.note: The two-time MVP threw a TD in each of the first three quarters, including a four-yard toss to Noah Gray in the third that gave Kansas City a 24-13 lead, but Mahomes got shut out of the end zone over the final 15 minutes as Denver staged a comeback. It was the second three-touchdown performance of the season for Mahomes as well as his second 300-yard effort, after he threw for 382 yards and three scores against the Colts in Week 2. He'll look to keep rolling in Week 9 against a Jets defense that's allowed three straight quarterbacks to produce at least three TDs against it.

news.h: Kansas City Chiefs' late collapse vs. Denver Broncos opens up AFC West race
news.d: Prior to Sunday's game, the Chiefs were 80-2 when leading by 10 or more in the fourth quarter under Patrick Mahomes.

news.h: Broncos use last-second goal-line stand to hold off Chiefs
news.d: Kansas City and Patrick Mahomes got the ball to the Denver 4-yard line with 35 seconds to play but were held out of the end zone on five straight plays.
